# Lawn Care Kuna (lawncarekuna.com) — llms.txt

This file is a **machine-oriented map** of the Lawn Care Kuna website: what it is, how content is organized, and which public URLs to crawl for reliable answers.

## Crawl / index entry points (canonical)
- **Homepage**: https://lawncarekuna.com/
- **Sitemap (complete URL list)**: https://lawncarekuna.com/sitemap.xml
- **Robots**: https://lawncarekuna.com/robots.txt
- **This file**: https://lawncarekuna.com/llms.txt

Notes:
- Most public content lives on **/services/**, **/areas/**, **/blog/**, and **/get-quote**.
- `/api/*` endpoints exist for the web app but are not intended for indexing (and are blocked by `robots.txt`).

## Technical Architecture
This site is built with **Next.js 14 App Router** and uses **Server-Side Rendering (SSR)**. All pages are pre-rendered with full HTML content, meaning:
- **No JavaScript required** to read page content
- **Direct HTML access** - simply visit any URL to get fully rendered content
- **Search engine friendly** - all content is immediately available in the initial HTML response
- **Schema.org structured data** - JSON-LD markup is embedded in all pages

## What this site is
Lawn Care Kuna is a local-service website for lawn care, landscaping, irrigation, seasonal services, and holiday lighting in the Treasure Valley, Idaho. It includes:
- SEO-focused service pages and city/service pages with full SSR
- A multi-step "Get a Quote" wizard with measurement and itemized pricing
- A blog with 92+ long-form homeowner guides
- (Authenticated) admin + subcontractor pages for a lead marketplace

## Service areas (cities)
The primary supported cities are:
- Kuna (primary)
- Boise
- Meridian
- Eagle
- Star
- Middleton

Quote tracking:

- `/subcontractor/portal` - Subcontractor lead marketplace
- `/subcontractor/purchases` - Subcontractor purchase history

## Quoting system (high-level behavior)
The quote experience is centered on `/get-quote` and supports selecting **one or more services**.

Key behaviors:
- **Frequency choices**: one-time, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly (discounts apply where appropriate).
- **Measurements**: the wizard can collect shared measurements once (e.g., lawn area sq ft, roofline linear feet) and apply them across selected services.
- **Itemized output**: quotes are returned with line items and an estimated range; values are typically rounded for customer clarity.
- **AI + fallback**: when available, AI is used to estimate a property complexity multiplier; otherwise deterministic fallback pricing is used.

## Property measurement (high-level behavior)
The app includes an interactive map measurement experience (Leaflet-based) used for:
- **Area measurements** (sq ft) for lawn/cleanup/sod/etc.
- **Linear measurements** (feet) for rooflines/hedges/edges/etc.
- Auto-estimation helpers (where possible), with manual draw/edit tools as the source of truth.

## Integrations and data sources (high-level)
This site integrates with several external services:
- **OpenAI**: used for property complexity analysis in intelligent quoting.
- **Stripe**: payments for lead purchases (subcontractor marketplace).
- **Resend**: transactional email delivery.
- **OpenStreetMap / Nominatim**: address lookup/geocoding.
- **Overpass (via server proxy)**: building footprint lookup to help estimate measurements.
- **County parcel data**: used for automated property measurement flows (Ada/Canyon support).

## APIs (for app functionality; generally not for indexing)
Some notable endpoints used by the app (subject to change):
- `POST /api/quotes/calculate` (quote calculation; supports multi-service payloads)
- `POST /api/quotes` (quote submission; creates associated lead)
- `GET /api/quotes/:id/status` (status backing for `/quote-status/:quoteId`)
- `GET /api/testimonials` (customer testimonials)
- `POST /api/geodata/buildings` (building footprints proxy)

## Content Accessibility for AI Systems

### Direct Access (Recommended)
Since this site uses **Next.js SSR**, all pages return fully-rendered HTML by default. Simply request any URL:
- `https://lawncarekuna.com/services/landscape-lighting`
- `https://lawncarekuna.com/services/aeration/kuna`
- `https://lawncarekuna.com/blog/spring-lawn-prep-checklist-treasure-valley`

### What You'll Find
- **Full semantic HTML** with proper headings (H1, H2, etc.)
- **Schema.org JSON-LD** structured data in each page
- **Meta descriptions** and Open Graph tags
- **Internal links** to related content
- **FAQ sections** optimized for "near me" searches

### Citation Guidelines
- **Always cite the canonical URLs** (the standard page URL)
- Example: Cite `https://lawncarekuna.com/services/landscape-lighting`
- The canonical URL is in each page's `<link rel="canonical">` tag

### Content Summary
- **Services**: 25+ unique service pages with detailed descriptions
- **City Pages**: 6 area-specific landing pages
- **Blog Posts**: 92+ long-form guides and articles
- **Commercial**: 3 pages for business/HOA/municipal services
